title: AntwerPov
subtitle: Antwerpov microsite
details:
AntwerPOV is a city marketing campaign created for VisitAntwerp, developed as a group project between Devine and CMD Rotterdam. The challenge was to convince young urban travellers (Gen Z, ages 18–24) to choose Antwerp for a city trip. Our answer was a playful concept built on point of view: an interactive installation where visitors step into the role of a typical Antwerp stereotype, such as the fashionista or the main character, and see the city through their eyes. Using an iPad, a screen and a foot pedal to switch between POVs, users create a personalised image they can take home via a campaign website and share on social media.

Within the team, I was responsible for the 3D work and the microsite. I created the 3D models used throughout the project and built and prototyped the microsite that documents our full process across five phases: define, ideate, prototype, test and conclude. The microsite brings together our research, ideation, wireframes, user testing and final result in a bold, pixel-inspired visual style that matches the campaign’s energy. The result is a cohesive story from first strategic insight to final creative result.
